narrative.intro: Southwest Valley Constructors has $2.5B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Southwest Valley Constructors recorded 7 awards in the current fiscal-year-to-date period, with an average award size of $355M. The Department of Homeland Security is the primary buyer for Southwest Valley Constructors, having obligated $2.5B, and the Department of Defense has provided $11.9M. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the largest NAICS market for Southwest Valley Constructors at $2.5B, while Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction accounts for $11.9M. Fiscal-year comparisons for Southwest Valley Constructors show FY21 obligations of $78.4M and FY2026 obligations of $2.5B, reflecting material changes in scale between those reporting periods. Current-year totals for Southwest Valley Constructors are partial because the period is fiscal year to date. Use these figures for assessing scale, agency concentration, and market exposure when considering teaming, capture, or compliance tasks related to Southwest Valley Constructors.

sections.heading: ?How concentrated are Southwest Valley Constructors obligations by agency and market?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security obligated $2.5B to Southwest Valley Constructors in FY2026 to date, making DHS the primary buyer. The Department of Defense obligated $11.9M to Southwest Valley Constructors. This mix shows high concentration of Southwest Valley Constructors work in building construction under DHS.
